title: mini tongs
text: mini tongs. I purchased these to try to use with our toaster oven... to carefully remove toast and other things without burning fingers... but they are a bit too short for this task.. but that's ok... I put them with my entertaining stuff.  They would be perfect for appetizers as others have noted.  They are what I would consider a "medium" weight.  Not a super heavy duty.. but reasonable.  They say they are stainless - but recommend hand washing.  SHOULD be able to go into the stainless basket of your dishwasher... but I have not tried this yet.  I will update my review if I see any issues.  I think these will be useful in my entertainment box of tricks.  :) They are about 4 or 4 1/2" long...  stainless in appearance.  Hope this helps!
